public_data: Hash exact existing projection/producer chain; allow_pickle=false; exact label-free public fields features,edge_index,train_mask,val_mask,test_mask; preserve row order and masks; raw FP32 finite24492x300; int64 edges; no labels in public graph.

construction: Seed Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/selected-device CUDA; instantiate/reset native once at member seed; GNNM wraps once after native reset and archives before/after factor RNG; optimizer built after ownership transfer; no post-wrap reset.

validity: Check finite full all-node logits, loss, all active gradients, post-update active parameters/Adam tensors and each member connectivity; stage-declared inactive gradients may be None. No all-trainable-gradient assertion that incorrectly rejects inactive global/local heads.
selection: Evaluate full graph after every actual update; strict correct-count VAL accuracy, earliest tie, first update eligible, same best record through both stages. GNNM softmax class axis then FP32 arithmetic probability mean; native argmax(logits). Never consult control outcome in selector.
transition: After200 actual local updates preserve current RNG, restore local-best model+Adam tensors/counters only, explicitly set correct native/wrapper _global=true, then continue current RNG. Save transition-before/after evidence; actual elapsed updates stay200 even Adam state rewinds.
final_restore: After2700 actual updates restore overall best model and saved _global; a local checkpoint may win. Every independent fit retains own chosen stage/epoch. Do not force global final or reset selector.
checkpoint: Follow CHECKPOINT_CONTRACT.json; immutable per-selected-update state images, local transition record and final exact image reference; selected raw FP32 full logits and validation correct-count independently replayed after portable reopening.
trace: Contiguous actual_update1..2700; author display_epoch0..2699; exact stage local1..200/global1..2500; loss, VAL correct_count/count, strict-selection event, checkpoint descriptor, restored-from update and _global for each event. No epoch0/untrained or patience stop.
terminal: Exclusive registered claims/output; capture prebody failures in ordinary CPU supervisor; atomically publish coherent success freeze; success requires successful physical process exit and unchanged admission/source/runtime/data/all-input/cost custody; keep every failure/trace/cost, no automatic retry.
cost: Complete process wall, preprocessing, local/global update+VAL times, checkpoint CPU copies/write/read and replay, active/peak GPU allocated/reserved and process RSS, total trainable/stored/optimizer/snapshot bytes. Original native single alias does not add a physical fit charge.
